title: Smaller law-column audit: first actual observation
instructions: Inputs, expected output, actual output and differences are shown in order. The agent evaluates the returned claims against the saved source image. Comments are optional; this is not a permission request. Enter your name to comment, Save draft to keep unfinished feedback, or Submit review to send it.

questions.prompt: Optional comments to steer later work

evidence.label: 1 · Inputs: original text, image and older model proposal
evidence.text:
The compact audit receives four source targets in two law columns. All original target text, the image and the complete older proposal are retained. The model is asked to report source-supported discrepancies and inspection coverage for every target; this is an audit, not a new corrected transcription. The following are exact excerpts for orientation, in original OCR then older-proposal order:

Chap. CCCXLI.—An Act to remove the Office

The compact source input, image, original words and older proposal are preserved. Reply-contract metadata, instructions and response schema change: one coverage record and concise source-bound concerns replace duplicated inspection/checklist records. Independent decoding restores the original source content, keeping that output metadata change explicit. Expected answers below were saved separately before these calls and were not inserted into the model prompt.

evidence.label: 3 · Actual run 1: exact model reply
4 · Differences: agent evaluation against the source
evidence.text:
Run 1 — All4target records appear, but the reply uses mostly single-character quotes/readings/reasons, includes unchanged e→e and duplicate punctuation concerns. Host validation rejects the no-op; unique source anchoring would also fail for repeated single characters. No supported chapter correction is returned despite complete coverage claims. It finishes normally with known usage/positive shutdown, so this invalid observation is retained and identical planned repetitions continue.

Only the first of three planned observations exists. Later calls remain subject to feedback, known usage, positive shutdown and the original limits.

The detailed assessment records each source check and any extra finding. Software format checks, model self-reports, source-image AI assessment and human judgment remain separate. Agreement between repeated calls alone is not accuracy. Original sources, older proposals and human answers are unchanged.

evidence.label: 5 · Costs, capacity and remaining limits
evidence.text: Observed request cycles total 139.09 seconds. Known reported usage totals 10,965 input and 196 output tokens; 0 calls have unknown usage. The complete original audit request is retained. Earlier literal text counts exceed the 6,000 reporting threshold before image accounting; this is not proof of internal input fit. Each call retains the 300-second lifecycle allowance and 1,500-token output cap. This version changes the audit reply format, not the original source or these limits. Known-usage, positive-stop invalid or length-capped replies remain planned observations; unknown usage/exit and exhausted budgets still block dependent calls. An incomplete or truncated reply remains a failure, and unknown usage or owned exit prevents dependent calls. No retries, source fetches, model downloads, Computer Use or corpus-wide run.
